items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: That's Rico's Alexis, brother. Kingston's Alexis.

ctx.x: Let's get his full name again, huh? Kingston what?
That's Rico's Alexis, brother. Kingston's Alexis.
Yeah, well good, I wanted to get it. I didn't know if we had it down or not. Alexis.
